title: Rental Late-Renewal Premiums: Utility Line Plan Bundle Credit
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts late-renewal premium carries a line-plan bundle credit read from the landlord's Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans holdings.

| The landlord holds an active utility line protection plan | Premium payments posted on the landlord's line plans in the 12 months before the late renewal | Line-plan bundle credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | 0.05 |
| yes | 6 to 11 | 0.03 |
| yes | fewer than 6 | 0 |
| no | any | 0 |

**Records read.** From the Utility Line Protection Plans records: the landlord's line plans and their status, and the premium payments posted in the line plans' billing history, with their dates.

**How the credit acts.** Every loading and credit on a late-renewal premium enters one adjustment rate — loadings added, credits subtracted — and the premium is multiplied once by one plus that rate, before rounding.

*Hypothetical:* a landlord with an active Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan, with 12 payments posted in the 12 months, takes 0.05; with 9 payments, 0.03.
